description:
AI-powered desktop workspace manager

CoolDesk is an AI-powered desktop workspace manager that organizes your browser tabs, apps, and workflows. It features a global spotlight search, smart tab grouping, workspace management, and real-time sync across browsers.
What's new in 2.0.21
Includes everything from 2.0.20, which was out for a few hours and never reached winget.
✨ Added
- Single | Multi switch in Browse's toolbar, with its own focus-mode button.
- Scratch notes. A New note button (the Tabs header, the multi view bar and the new-tab screen) opens a note that stays with its tab until you save it to a workspace.
- A blank tab offers a shell, a note or your files, right on the new-tab screen. It no longer opens Home in the side panel.
🐛 Fixed
- Claude Code and other full-screen programs drew garbled in terminal tabs — lines at the wrong width, overwriting each other. The shell now always gets the terminal's real size once it starts, and symbols and emoji are measured with Unicode 11 widths.
- The sidebar's shell said "Couldn't start a shell". Since the sidebar became its own window in 2.0.19, the terminal only accepted the main window and Spotlight. Shells now start in the sidebar and bar windows too.
- The file manager stays usable in narrow multi view tiles — its sidebar becomes a drawer and the preview keeps its room.
- A folder tile went blank in multi view when you clicked another tile, like a shell next to it. Folder tiles now stay on screen; only the tile you're in takes the keyboard.
- The sidebar's folder browser was squeezed to a few rows by an empty preview pane under the list. It's a full-height list again.
📦 Install
─────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Platform             │Download
─────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Chrome extension     │Chrome Web Store — or cooldesk-extension-2.0.21.zip
─────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Windows              │CoolDesk_2.0.21_x64-setup.exe — or winget install
                     │CoolDesk.CoolDesk
─────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
macOS (Apple Silicon)│CoolDesk_2.0.21_aarch64.dmg — or via Homebrew (below)
─────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Linux                │CoolDesk_2.0.21_amd64.AppImage (any distro)
─────────────────────┴──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
macOS via Homebrew:
brew tap abhayraghuwanshi/cooldesk https://github.com/abhayraghuwanshi/cooldesk-extension
brew install --cask cooldesk   # or: brew upgrade --cask cooldesk
If macOS says the app is damaged (it isn't notarized yet):
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/CoolDesk.app
Full changelog: docs/CHANGELOG.md
